name: Armour of Faith
text: This fighter refuses to wear any armour, and is always considered to be in Cover.

name: Doom
text: Select each enemy fighter within 6" of this fighter. Until the end of the battle round, those fighters cannot make reactions.

name: Foresight
text: Select a friendly fighter within 6" of this fighter. Until the end of the battle round, all hit rolls targeting that fighter hit on a 5+, no matter the attacker's Fight or Shoot characteristics.

name: Hammer of Sigmar
text: A fighter can only use this ability if equipped with a Warhammer or Sigmarite Hammer. Add (X/2) to the damage points allocated to enemy fighters by each hit and critical hit from the next melee attack action made by this fighter in this activation.

name: Lead By Example
text: A fighter can use this ability after taking an enemy fighter out of action. Select up to two visible friendly fighters with the `HENCHMAN` keyword within 6" of this fighter. Each of those fighters can make a free move or a free attack action.

name: Soulfire
text: Allocate (X/2) damage points to each visible enemy fighter within 6" of this fighter. If the enemy fighter is a `VAMPIRE`, `DAEMON` or `THRALL`, allocate (X) damage points instead.

name: Words of Healing
text: Remove (X/2) damage points allocated to each friendly fighter within 6" of this fighter. If you discard a saved wyrd dice, remove (X) damage points instead.
